segments.sourceText: 自然博物馆快开新展览了。小穿山甲岩岩收到一张任务卡：让大家看懂，地面为什么会摇？

segments.sourceText: A new exhibition was opening at the natural history museum. Yan-Yan the little pangolin had a job: help visitors discover why the ground shakes.
segments.spokenText: A new exhibition was opening at the natural history museum. Yan-Yan the little pangolin had a job: help visitors discover why the ground shakes.

segments.sourceText: 岩岩摆好两块岩石模型。它们安安静静，一点也不摇。“先别急，”讲解员说，“我们在馆里，慢慢看看大地模型怎样动。”

segments.sourceText: Yan-Yan set two model rock blocks in place. Nothing moved. “Take your time,” said the museum guide. “Here in the museum, we can watch our model Earth move slowly.”

segments.sourceText: “咦！这里没滑，那里已经变样了。”
segments.spokenText: “咦！这里没滑，那里已经变样了。”

segments.sourceText: Yan-Yan gently pushed the sides of the model toward each other. The seam stayed stuck, but the markings beside it bent.
segments.spokenText: Yan-Yan gently pushed the sides of the model toward each other. The seam stayed stuck, but the markings beside it bent.

segments.sourceText: “This part has not slipped, but that part is changing!”
segments.spokenText: “This part has not slipped, but that part is changing!”

segments.sourceText: 突然，接缝两边滑动了！弯着的纹路松回来一些，却没有全回到老地方。岩岩指着错开的线：
segments.spokenText: 突然，接缝两边滑动了！弯着的纹路松回来一些，却没有全回到老地方。岩岩指着错开的线：

segments.sourceText: “这就是它动过的痕迹。”
segments.spokenText: “这就是它动过的痕迹。”

segments.sourceText: Suddenly, the rocks slipped along the seam! The bent markings sprang back a little, but not all the way. Yan-Yan pointed at the offset lines.
segments.spokenText: Suddenly, the rocks slipped along the seam! The bent markings sprang back a little, but not all the way. Yan-Yan pointed at the offset lines.

segments.sourceText: “They show us where the rocks moved.”
segments.spokenText: “They show us where the rocks moved.”

segments.sourceText: “振动传到哪里了？”
segments.spokenText: “振动传到哪里了？”

segments.sourceText: 岩岩在地表摆好两面感应旗。你来帮他选位置，再猜猜，哪面旗先收到信号？

segments.sourceText: “Where have the vibrations reached?”
segments.spokenText: “Where have the vibrations reached?”

segments.sourceText: 岩岩盯住地下的一颗小标记。振动传过去时，它在原来的位置附近来回动，并没有跟着波跑到旗子那里。
